title: Flight Lab vehicle document with data provenance (FL-602)
description: A Flight Lab vehicle YAML: the OpenTsiolkovsky flight article (simulation window, attitude program, plain-number OT stages, optional booster section) plus a mandatory `data_provenance` sidecar that tags every number in the document `official`, `public_estimate` or `illustrative`, with a cited `source`, an `as_of` date and an optional symmetric `uncertainty_pct`. The `stages` entries are $refs to OpenTsiolkovsky's own cached config schema (injected by orbitopt.flightlab.vehicle_catalog.vehicle_schema), so the flight article stays exactly what the OT adapter passes through: plain numbers, no inline provenance nodes there. Inline provenance nodes ({value, provenance, source, ...}) are allowed only inside `booster`, where BoosterModel.load already reads them. Sidecar keys are document paths (`stages[0].engine.isp_vac_s`, `attitude_program`, `booster.engines.thrust_vacuum_n`); a key covers the numeric node or subtree it names, nearest match wins. Public-estimate vehicles must carry a `disclaimer` that they are not official performance data.

as_of.description: Date the document's figures were last checked against their sources.

disclaimer.description: Mandatory whenever the document carries public_estimate or official figures: states in what sense the vehicle is NOT official performance data of the named operator.

restart.description: Optional multi-burn (coast + re-ignition) schedule for one stage, E5-05b: the OT adapter synthesises a thrust-curve coast gap and a restart attitude leg from this block so stage 2 can coast ballistically and re-ignite (also the enabler for higher circularisation altitudes). Times are seconds after liftoff, matching attitude_program.

stage.description: 1-based index of the restarting stage; defaults to the last stage.

coast_start_s.description: Absolute time (s after liftoff) to cut the main burn and begin the ballistic coast.

restart_thrust_n.description: Constant vacuum thrust (N) through the restart burn.

restart_azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth (deg) commanded during the restart leg.

restart_elevation_deg.description: Elevation (deg) commanded during the restart leg.

geometry.description: Optional outer dimensions for the read-only Vehicle view (Flight Lab sidebar). Not flown: no propagator or adapter reads it. Without it the view draws a schematic from the stage diameters and masses and says so. Every number needs a data_provenance entry (`geometry` covers the subtree).

stages.description: Stage lengths bottom-up, in the order of `stages`.

diameter_m.description: Overrides the stage's aero.diameter_m for the drawing only.

nose.description: The nose of the stack's top stage, part of that stage's length (not added to it). With it the aero curves of every stage (`ca`, `ca_power_off`, `cn_alpha_per_rad`) are generated by orbitopt.flightlab.nose_aero and a test holds the committed numbers equal to the generated ones.

base_diameter_m.description: Defaults to the top stage's aero.diameter_m.

UncertaintyPct.description: Symmetric half-width of the uncertainty band, percent of the value; the form FL-304 Monte Carlo dispersions consume directly.
